profile.headline: Software Engineer at H&R Block
profile.summary:
I’m a software engineer focused on modernizing large-scale enterprise systems using Angular, C#, .NET, and SQL. At H&R Block, I help evolve a platform used by 60,000+ tax professionals by integrating AI-driven features, improving authentication and security, rebuilding legacy interfaces into Angular micro apps, and automating deployments and infrastructure with Azure DevOps and Terraform.

Before software, I worked as a winemaker. The wine industry taught adaptability, resourcefulness, and strong problem-solving under pressure. Those same skills shape my approach to engineering today: build thoughtfully, reduce complexity, and deliver solutions that make workflows easier for both users and developers.

Technical Skills: C#, .NET, TypeScript, Angular, React, Python, Django, SQL, Docker, Azure DevOps, Terraform

-Conducted code reviews and provided 1:1 support for student projects and web applications

positions.title: Proprietor, Winemaker
positions.description:
-Founded and grew a wine brand, developing new business through consultative sales with restaurants, retailers, distributors, and hospitality accounts
-Built long-term customer relationships with over 20 accounts by understanding business needs, and negotiating pricing, placements, and account strategy
-Delivered product presentations, tastings, and educational events, breaking down technical production for buyers and hospitality partners
-Owned end-to-end operations for a physical goods business, balancing customer demand, production constraints, timelines, and quality standards while increasing annual production 10% year over year

positions.title: Operations Lead
positions.description:
Managed partner and client relationships to provide efficient and effective technical wine solutions
Created experimental protocols to enhance quality of 12 estate wines, implementing new lab analyses methods and tracking repeatability
Restructured team responsibilities based on individual strengths, increasing productivity by 30%
